description: This file declares the FlagForwarder class, which manages subprocess flags and provides methods to update flag defaults and generate argument vectors for subprocesses.

classes.name: FlagForwarder
classes.description: A class that manages subprocess flags and provides methods to update and generate command-line arguments.

methods.name: FlagForwarder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FlagForwarder with a set of subprocesses and arguments.

methods.name: UpdateFlagDefaults
methods.description: Updates the default flags for subprocesses.

methods.name: ArgvForSubprocess
methods.description: Generates argument vector for a specified subprocess, optionally appending additional arguments.
